units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:16">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> <he>זקנה שיש בה ל׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="L00552"><he>לכלוכית</he></cite>) old age combined with vitality.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61">Gen. R. s. 61</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>יונקתו</he>, <cite ref="Job 14:7">Job XIV, 7</cite>) <he>זו ל׳ שלו</he> that means his vitality.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:8">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>עדיין לי׳ של וכ׳</he> David was yet in full vigor.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 92b:8">Ib. 92ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 37:4">Ez. XXXVII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Ezekiel 37:11">11</cite>) ‘dry bones’ are men <he>שאין בהם ל׳ של מצוה</he> in whom there is no sap of good deeds; <cite ref="Sotah 46b:23">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 226">Yalk. Kings 226</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:4">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>ועלה ל׳</he>, read: <cite ref="L00552"><he>לִכְלוּכִית</he></cite>.]
